note: Graded at the end of every turn by .referee/scripts/audit.mjs. Each rule passes, fails, or is n/a when its trigger never happened. Add a rule for every mistake you never want twice.

rules.why: If the router named a skill for the request, the agent loaded it before its first file edit in that turn.
PRs follow the repo's title and description rules.
The configured independent reviewer ran before the PR was opened.
The agent ran the proving checks, with evidence, before opening a PR.
Review findings were verified and triaged, not applied blindly.
When ship ran, the agent computed readiness instead of claiming it.
Merging is the human's call unless they said "full send".
Skipping git hooks skips the repo's own checks.
An agent that keeps hitting the guard is working around a rule instead of fixing the cause.
